Name: Asaiah, Son of Haggiah
Summary: Son of Haggiah in Merari's line, named among David's singers' families.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 6:30; 1 Chronicles 15:6; 1 Chronicles 15:11: Son of Haggiah in Merari's line, named among David's singers' families.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Asaiah stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.
